scholarships.title: Beca para hijas e hijos de profesionales de la educación
scholarships.official_source: Ministerio de Educación de Chile (Mineduc), published on ChileAtiende, the official portal of the Government of Chile

eligibility: Be the son or daughter of a professional or of education support staff (personal asistente de educación) working in a municipal, particular subvencionado or administración delegada establishment
Belong to the 80% most vulnerable group according to the Registro Social de Hogares
New entrants: 510 points or above (scale 100-1,000) on the compulsory PAES tests and a secondary-school average (NEM) of 5.5 or above
Already studying: 510 points or above on the PAES, or 500 points or above (scale 150-850) on the PDT/PSU, plus the NEM and annual pass-rate conditions
Enrol at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026
existing.eligibility_summary: Students who are children of teachers or education assistants working in municipal, subsidised private or delegated-administration schools, and whose household is within the 80% most vulnerable segment according to the Registro Social de Hogares. Open both to students newly entering a degree and to those already studying one, with different academic conditions for each.
benefits: CLP 500,000 towards the annual tuition of a degree
Available to new entrants and to students already enrolled, whether or not they already hold a student credit
coverage: A fixed economic support of CLP 500,000 applied to the annual tuition (arancel anual) of a degree at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026
requirements: File the application through the FUAS website of Beneficios Estadulantiles using RUT or ClaveÚnica
Prove the parental or guardianship link to a professional or education assistant working in an eligible establishment
Meet the academic conditions for the new-entrant or continuing-student route
Upload documents during the Mineduc document window
documents: Evidence of the parent's or guardian's role in an eligible school
PAES or PDT/PSU results as applicable
Proof of enrolment and annual pass rates for continuing students
application_method: Online application through the FUAS website of Beneficios Estudiantiles
Results checked on the Beneficios Estudiantiles site
existing.selection_notes: The official page does not publish ranking criteria; the benefit is granted on the basis of FUAS data plus State records.
existing.best_fit: Students from low-income households whose parent or guardian works as a teacher or education assistant in a Chilean public, subsidised private or delegated-administration school.
existing.notes: Students entering higher education through the PACE programme are explicitly exempted from the academic-score requirements, which makes this the most accessible Mineduc need-based scholarship for PACE entrants who are children of educators. The award is a fixed CLP 500,000, so it will not necessarily cover the full tuition at higher-cost institutions.
existing.duration: Annual, tied to the Chilean academic year and to the admission cycle in which the benefit is assigned; renewals are handled in the same annual process.
existing.application_period: 1 to 22 October 2026 for the 2027 admission cycle (official wording: "Postulación: del 1 al 22 de octubre 2026"), filed through the FUAS website.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for the 2027 admission cycle close on 22 October 2026.

scholarships.title: Beca Nuevo Milenio
scholarships.official_source: Ministerio de Educación de Chile (Mineduc), published on ChileAtiende, the official portal of the Government of Chile

eligibility: Within the 70% most vulnerable group per the Registro Social de Hogares (within the 50% band for the higher Nuevo Milenio II amount)

Enrolled in a degree at a Centro de Formación Técnica, Instituto Profesional, university or armed-forces school accredited as at 31 December 2026, or exempt from accreditation by Mineduc for the cycle
First-year students: no existing higher-education technical or professional degree or terminal licenciatura
Continuing students (higher years): 60% of first-year subjects passed to reach second year, 70% of second-year subjects to reach third year
Not have received a Mineduc tuition scholarship as a first-year student on two separate occasions
existing.eligibility_summary: Chilean students in the lowest-income segment of the population according to the Registro Social de Hogares, with a secondary-school average of 5.0 or above, enrolling in or continuing a degree at a technical training centre, professional institute, university or armed-forces school. Two income bands are funded: up to CLP 600,000 for the lowest-income 70% and up to CLP 860,000 for the lowest-income 50% at institutions accredited for three years.
benefits: Up to CLP 600,000 per year of the annual tuition (Nuevo Milenio)
Up to CLP 860,000 per year of the annual tuition (Nuevo Milenio II, for the lowest-income 50% at three-year-accredited institutions)
250 reserved places for students registered with a disability
coverage: Beca Nuevo Milenio: up to CLP 600,000 of the annual tuition for students in the 70% lowest-income group
Beca Nuevo Milenio II: up to CLP 860,000 of the annual tuition for students in the 50% lowest-income group enrolled at institutions accredited for three years
requirements: File the application through the FUAS website of Beneficios Estudiantiles using RUT or ClaveÚnica
Enrol at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026, or one that Mineduc has exempted from accreditation for the cycle
For continuing students, meet the annual subject-pass thresholds
documents: Proof of enrolment at an eligible institution
application_method: Online application through the FUAS website of Beneficios Estudiantiles
Results checked on the Beneficios Estudiantiles site
existing.selection_notes: The official page does not publish ranking criteria; the benefit is granted on the basis of FUAS data plus State records.
existing.best_fit: Low-income Chilean students entering or continuing an undergraduate, technical or professional degree, with a larger award available for the poorest half of the distribution at long-accredited institutions.
existing.notes: Two award bands sit under one name: CLP 600,000 for the lowest-income 70% and CLP 860,000 for the lowest-income 50% at institutions accredited for three years. The award also carries 250 places reserved for students with a disability, which is how the separate disability scholarship is funded.
existing.duration: Annual, tied to the Chilean academic year and to the admission cycle in which the benefit is assigned; continuing students must pass 60% of first-year subjects to reach second year and 70% of second-year subjects to reach third year.
existing.application_period: 1 to 22 October 2026 for the 2027 admission cycle (official wording: "Postulación: del 1 al 22 de octubre 2026"), filed through the FUAS website.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for the 2027 admission cycle close on 22 October 2026.
